Geographies Served Programs Women Empowerment Programme CORP gives women new opportunities to earn, and motivates them to think differently about their futures through vocational courses in tailoring mehendi and beauty. The skills acquired from our programmes provide women with the ability to seek outside employment or to work from home. Our income generation programme provide women job training and a source of income to support their family Creche - Daycare Programme In Creche programme children of poor working mothers are provided with safe, caring environments so they are not neglected while family members are busy. Knowing that their children are being looked after enables many women to step outside the home to earn a living. Thousands of children are benefited each year on the core activities of enabling a child’s physical, mental, and social development through education, nutrition and health. About Headquarters Mumbai, Maharashtra Since 1977 Demographies Served Women Children --> Impact CORP has reached over one million women and children in 13 slum communities across greater Mumbai since 1977, with thousands benefiting each year from their various programs and services. Vision and Mission CORP believes in self-sufficiency, not dependency. The key to living a dignified and self-respecting life. We also run a number of programmes that cater to the needs of the entire slum community. Our mission is to educate, nurture, and guide vulnerable children, to empower disadvantaged women, and to improve the living conditions of poor slum communities.
